{{Quote|So, why did Darth Nul have a lightsaber that was built like a Jedi's?|The [[Alliance Commander]]|<ref name="TOR:OW" />}}
A '''lightsaber''' was owned by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Darth Nul|Raniah]]<ref name="TOR:OW" /> centuries before the [[Great Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR:DN">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=codex|Darth Nul}}</ref> Raniah conserved her lightsaber after she became Darth Nul. Following her death, the lightsaber was kept in Nul's [[Darth Nul's archive|secret archive]]. Darth Nul's lightsaber was [[Duel in Darth Nul's archive|discovered]] by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Tau Idair]] during the [[Third Galactic War]]. Testing performed by Doctor [[Juvard Illip Oggurobb]] on [[Odessen]] revealed that Darth Nul had been a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] before becoming a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].<ref name="TOR:OW" />

When the [[Alliance Commander]] and [[Lana Beniko]] discovered the spirit of Darth Nul contained within a [[Rakatan]] [[mind prison]] in the ruins of the [[Emperor's Fortress]], Nul conjured an illusory replica of her lightsaber as she attempted to claim a new body for herself to escape, but was ultimately unable to defeat the pair.<ref name="Dark Heart" />
